text:
Nina Gomez: Heads up - Sycamore asked for a compact perf writeup + two commercial paths after the POC yesterday. Posting numbers and recommended ask.

Ravi Shah: I ran three deterministic runs using Sycamore's traffic template. Matrix: sustained 400 qps chat-gen, two 90s spikes to 1.8k qps spaced by 10m, embed mix ~200 qps. Model: redwood-13B-quant-latency. Pool: 5x A100-equivalent, autoscale on.

Ravi Shah: Aggregate (chat tokens): p50 88ms, p95 260ms, p99 920ms. Embeds p50 44ms, p95 150ms. During 1.8k spikes p99 rose to ~2.9s for ~22s correlated with autoscale and prefix KV miss surge. No request failures, retries negligible.

Ellen Wu: Short config snippet to include: 
```
workload:
  - chat_sustain: qps=400 duration=40m
  - spike: qps=1800 duration=90s
  - embeds: qps=200
autoscaler: min_idle=1 scale_cooldown_s=25
prefix_kv_ttl_s=900
```

Carlos Mendes: Infra notes: main tail cause = KV attach + kernel warm paths when new workers join. With min_idle=1 + pre-populate top prefixes, retest shows p99 during spikes <1.1s. Observed brief network egress queue on node-5 for ~14s; mitigation: increase node egress buffer and stagger spike by 3s when orchestrating load tests.

Nina Gomez: Pricing asks: can we give a consumption estimate and a short reserved pilot price for them to choose? They want predictable latency for their live pilot.

Ravi Shah: Cost telemetry: this 40m sustain + bursts run ~=2.6 GPU-hours, estimated run cost ~$1,050.

Carlos Mendes: Commercials we recommend:
- Consumption: $0.13 / 1k chat tokens, $0.02 / 1k embed tokens. Based on Sycamore forecast (2.2M tokens/day) => ~ $8.8k/mo.
- Reserved pilot (recommended): 3-month pilot, dedicated pool sized for 450 qps sustained + 2x burst buffer and 1 warm node, flat $6,400/mo (includes 24/7 warm buffer, SLA, one free 24hr pre-warm at pilot start).

Ellen Wu: Customer note text suggestion: "Short bench: sustained 400 qps with p95 ~260ms and p99 ~920ms. Under 1.8k spikes p99 temporarily rose to ~2.9s due to autoscale and KV attach; enabling a 1-warm-node buffer and prefix pre-population keeps p99 <1.1s. See attached run artifacts and quick ops playbook."

Nina Gomez: Ops attachments: please include ops-bot link, run playbook, and a one-paragraph explanation of why p99 spikes occur and how pre-warm fixes them.

ops-bot: Artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/poc-runs/3098765432/ (prom, histograms, loadgen config, flamegraphs).

Nina Gomez: I'll send this to Sycamore in the next hour. Comments/edits?

Ravi Shah: +1 from SE. Add: we offer a 24hr free pre-warm at pilot start to validate against their real traffic profile.

Carlos Mendes: +1 from infra. I'll include the short checklist for their infra team.

Ellen Wu: +1 on wording. I'm attaching the pricing worksheet and SOW draft after this thread.
